prompt: Create an original 180 second instrumental funk instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: clavinet, slap bass, tight drums, rhythm guitar. Style: sixteenth-note syncopation with short call-and-response riffs. Tempo approximately 104 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: An energetic instrumental track featuring a driving drum beat, groovy bassline, and prominent electric guitars with both rhythmic and melodic parts, including a lead solo. It has a modern rock/funk fusion feel.
description.zh: 一首充满活力的器乐曲，以强劲的鼓点、律动的贝斯线和突出的电吉他为主，包含节奏和旋律部分，并有电吉他独奏。整体风格融合了现代摇滚和放克元素。
